# With a path prefix, a link across packages carries the prefix once. Both
# routes functions get the same "/app", so admin's page links to
# /app/article/42 and that URL serves.

muxt generate
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server",
		"output_routes_func_with_path_prefix_param": true
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a id="article" href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestPrefixAppearsOnce(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{}, "/app")
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{}, "/app")

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/app/admin", nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("GET /app/admin status = %d, want %d", got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	if body, want := rec.Body.String(), `href="/app/article/42"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("GET /app/admin body = %q, want it to contain %q", body, want)
	}

	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/app/article/42", nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("GET /app/article/42 status = %d, want %d", got, http.StatusOK)
	}
}
